Title
: The Saturday Evening Post Collectible Tin Mineral Rocks May 7 1932 Local
Department
: Collectibles & Art
Condition
: Used
Description
: Discover a unique addition to your collection with this vintage collectible tin containing an assortment of rough mineral and rock specimens. The classic metal tin, featuring charming imagery from The Saturday Evening Post dated May 7, 1932, adds nostalgic appeal and a decorative touch, making this set perfect for display as well as storage. Inside, you'll find a variety of unpolished mineral stones in assorted natural shadesearthy browns, creamy whites, rusty reds, yellows, and the occasional black or grayeach one offering its own distinctive shape, color, and surface texture. These handpicked rocks are ideal for beginner geologists, educational collections, or anyone who enjoys the raw beauty of natural minerals. The metal tin keeps everything together and displays well on shelves or desks. Please note that both the tin and the stones show typical evidence of age and handling, including small surface marks and overall wear, which only add to their authentic, timeworn character
